setup.standalone.welcome_intro: Social Home is the social space for your household. We’ll set up the first admin so you can sign in and start inviting the rest of your household.

recoveryKit.title: Disaster recovery — Recovery Kit
recoveryKit.intro: A Recovery Kit is a single sealed file that can restore your whole household onto fresh hardware after a disk loss or stolen server. Generate one now, download it, and store it somewhere safe and offline.
recoveryKit.warn_passphrase: Keep this passphrase safe — it is the only key to the Kit and cannot be recovered. Lose it and the Kit is useless.
recoveryKit.warn_regenerate: The Kit captures your trust with paired households at this moment. After you pair with new households, regenerate it so a restore brings them back too.
recoveryKit.err_required: Enter a passphrase to protect the Kit.
recoveryKit.err_too_short: Passphrase must be at least 8 characters.
